architecture: supervised MLP head (384→64→32→8) trained on explicitly labeled upholstery swatches; DINOv2 backbone frozen
embedding: 384D mean non-CLS patch tokens; L2 normalized; full/center/corner crops from each labeled swatch averaged per physical swatch
sourceDataset: iFurnPlus upholstery/material swatch catalog; Albabeds 2026 labeled fabric swatch chart; Perfect Modern labeled upholstery swatch products. Labels derived from explicit catalog/product names.
validationMethod: 5-fold stratified group CV with one averaged vector per physical swatch. Some color variants from the same fabric family can appear in different folds; not a benchmark on real sofa photos.
